messages:
Omar (finance): Quick company-wide note: we're doing a year-start vendor sanity check and tightening a couple of p-card rules. Please review your recurring vendors and update the intake by Feb 5. Short links + checklist: https://docs.redwood.internal/yearstart-vendors-2026 :loudspeaker:
Priya (procurement): Summary: p-card single-charge cap lowered to $1,000; recurring subscriptions > $75/mo must be entered. Delegated approvals allowed for low-risk SaaS <= $1,800/yr (team lead sign-off).
Sam (eng): For marketplace charges billed via cloud invoices, include them in the intake?
Priya (procurement): Yes  include any external recurring line item, even if billed through a cloud provider.
Jules (sales): We have a partner trial billed $0 for now but will convert to $150/mo after launch. Still add it?
Omar (finance): Add it and mark expected monthly_amount. If it crosses thresholds, procurement will reach out.
Linda (legal): If a vendor handles customer data, mark "handles_pii" so legal/security can review. Expedite requests = ping me after intake.
procure-bot: Intake template updated at 07:00 UTC. Fields: vendor_name, monthly_estimate, cost_center, owner_email, contract_term, handles_pii, expedite_flag.
Omar (finance): Action: teams update intake by 2026-02-05 COB. Non-listed recurring vendors after the sweep may face payment delays. Post exceptions in #help-procurement and tag @Priya. :memo:
